scope.follow_up: Inference-Time Threats was re-audited occurrence by occurrence for direct support and primary-source attribution.
scope.method: Five section audits plus follow-up verification against primary paper full text and authoritative arXiv, DBLP, ACL, NeurIPS, USENIX, IEEE, ACM, OpenReview and PMLR metadata. Secondary carrier citations were replaced with original papers, rewritten as current-paper results, or removed from generic synthesis.

representative_primary_source_repairs: GCG now cites Zou et al.'s original paper rather than related-work carrier passages.
The two distinct AutoDAN methods are disambiguated and cite their respective original papers.
PAIR, TAP, AdvPrompter, many-shot jailbreaking, HarmBench and StrongREJECT cite their original papers.
Spectral signatures cite Tran, Li and Madry rather than later papers that mention the method.
RankPoison cites RLHFPoison; web-scale poisoning cites Carlini et al.; sleeper agents cite Hubinger et al.
HaluEval, SelfCheckGPT, TruthX, StruQ, SecAlign, Jatmo, AgentDojo, InjecAgent, PoisonedRAG and Instruction Hierarchy cite their primary papers.
Unsupported or generic secondary attributions were removed or rewritten without a false citation.

strict_dblp_manifest.meaning: All 121 cited BibTeX entries were rebuilt from canonical live DBLP records, pinned by SHA-256 in the manifest, and accepted by PaperHunter's strict citation-integrity gate.

assurance: The audit verifies direct textual support and primary-source attribution; it does not independently reproduce the cited experiments. Mechanical duplicate and cross-reference checks pass. All 121 cited entries now have canonical DBLP metadata and pinned SHA-256 verification, and the strict DBLP-manifest gate passes.
